Comments: [Ref.24616110] Antimicrobial peptide active against Gram-positive bacteria like B.subtilis, S.aureus and L.monocytogenes as well as against Gram-negative bacteria like E.coli and P.aeruginosa with minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC) between 1.3 ?M and 35 ?M.Active against fungus C.albicans (MIC=6.3 ?M).Has little hemolytic activity . Name: Macropin 1(solitary bee, insects, animals)
